description: This file is a JavaScript client that establishes a WebSocket connection to a local server, sends a JSON-RPC request to perform an addition operation, and logs the response.

methods.name: client.onopen
methods.description: Event handler triggered when WebSocket connection opens; sends a JSON-RPC request to add two numbers.
